name: Kimizuka Hachiro
source:
A King Kong Company taxi driver that [url=/c73543]Minorikawa[/url] encounters on multiple occurrences.

[spoiler]A year prior, he was a school teacher who taught most of the members of S.O.S. He stepped away from teaching and became a taxi driver.[/spoiler]
